kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستصلح (form X)
# أَسْتَصْلِحُ (ʔastaṣliḥu) /ʔas.tasˤ.li.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصْلَحَ (istaṣlaḥa)
# أَسْتَصْلِحَ (ʔastaṣliḥa) /ʔas.tasˤ.li.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَصْلَحَ (istaṣlaḥa)
# أَسْتَصْلِحْ (ʔastaṣliḥ) /ʔas.tasˤ.liħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَصْلَحَ (istaṣlaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
